items.t: CoreWeave has a clear message for investors worried about debt

items.t: CoreWeave Stocks Fall 10.19% as Nvidia Turmoil Deepens AI Cloud Selloff
items.sum: The Nvidia-backed AI cloud provider extended a two-day slide, even after Cathie Wood's ARK bought $16 million of shares on Thursday.

items.t: Applied Digital Sinks 10%, Nebius Down 13%, CoreWeave Down 11% as AI Data Center Selloff Resumes
items.sum: Key TakeawaysApplied Digital fell 10% this morning with Nebius, CoreWeave and Cipher Digital after Nebius’s soft outlook. Applied Digital had no news of its own: the drop reflects sentiment toward its tenants.

items.t: Nebius Sinks 13% as Baird and BofA Slash Price Targets Over Data Center Delays; CoreWeave Tumbles 11%, NVIDIA Falls 4%
items.sum: Wall Street is losing patience with the data center expansion timeline at Nebius Group (NASDAQ:NBIS). Nebius stock is at $111.34 in morning trading, down 13%. That drop compounds a steep stretch, leaving Nebius stock down 46% over the past month. Two Wall Street firms cut their price targets on Nebius on November 13, citing delays […]

items.t: Here’s Who’s Getting Dragged Down Further as Huang Exits: CoreWeave Vs. Super Micro Computer
items.sum: Two AI infrastructure stocks posted blowout quarters, then Nvidia's CEO walked out and a federal probe landed. One company carries the debt, the other carries the legal cloud. Which one has more to fear?

items.t: CoreWeave Jumped 16% After Earnings but Is Still Down 47% in a Year. Can the Rebound Last?
items.sum: CoreWeave just raised prices twice and has 130,000 GPU contracts coming up for renewal, yet a mountain of debt keeps swallowing its gains. Which force wins out, and how much does it matter for the stock's next leg?
